Name: More Mixed Seeds from Weeds
Author: minami26
Description:
[list]
[*][b][size=3]Increased Mixed Seeds drop from cutting Weeds a bit double the chance from vanilla (default).[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=3]Small chance to drop Mixed Flower Seeds regardless of season (can be disabled).[/size][/b]
[*][size=3][b]Configurable number of seeds dropped and drop rates.[/b][/size]
[*][b][size=3]When you have a certain book, chance is further increased to 4x than vanilla and have multiple mixed seed drops (default, configurable).[/size][/b]
[/list][size=3]* All functions of the mod are configurable in config.json. If you have GMCM installed you can edit them in-game.
[/size]
Another way of grabbing more mixed seeds in a no ∞ seeds in shops playthrough in v1.6, or if you just want more mixed seeds! enjoy!

Mods used in conjunction for this challenging run:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22311]Re-mixed Seeds[/url] - adds modded crops into mixed seeds (your choice of modded crops to add)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24195]No Seeds for Coin﻿[/url] - remove seeds from being sold in shops
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26086]Realistic Seasonal Shop Inventory[/url] - no more unlimited stocks in shops
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22231]Progressive Seed Maker[/url] - when you need more seeds after you've spent the whole day cutting weeds.
[url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-154]Unofficial Harvest Seeds[/url] - to be able to get back the seed on harvest and set you up for the next season.

Made almost all aspects of the mod configurable in the config.json file. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM Optional[/url].
Create/add in your translation files for the GMCM options.

Downloads.Description: Added new i18n translation file and functions for GMCM options. Fix: No more mixed seeds from Ice Crystals from the mines.
